title: Playing with Papa Celestin and his sidemen
summary: He recalls working with Celestin, who had Howard Davis, Harrison Brett and Gabriel in his band.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Sam says, now, but I wanted to ask you, get back to what we were talking about, all the different things. Were you a regular man with Celestan, a regular member of his band? Did you play with him as a sub?

No, I played with him, you know how Celestan was. He kept a fellow a while, you know when he had jobs, you know what I'm saying? I worked with him a while and then after winding up, he wound up with Albert French.
Who was in the band when you were with him? Well, when I was with him he had Paul Bones was with him, Howard Davis, do you remember Howard Davis?
I can't place him, what did he play?
He used to be a delegate for the Union Saxophone.
Remember Howard? No, I don't think that was...
You oughta know Howard Davis. Howard Davis was there with him.
I don't know him, but I know him.

Yeah. Howard Davis was with him. And then sometimes he used to use Harrison Brett. Harrison Brett played with him too. And he had, well, you see when Celestan came back after he had been sick so long, he had to restart all over again. You know he had high up with different groups, you understand? I mean he had to start from scratch in better words, you understand? He had Miss Kimball playing with him, you understand? And he had Manny Gabriel, he used to play with him, and he used to use Manny Gabriel's brother sometimes, and then he wound up on the last year using Rick Holland's bass.
Manny Gabriel's brother, what was Manny Gabriel playing then? Saxophone?

Saxophone, his brother played bass too. Yeah, I see. Yeah, yeah, he played bass too. You know what I'm saying? And he had, that's who he had in his band with him. And Howard used to do with the Delco Islands and different jobs, Tuscaloosa, Alabama, different other places. Did he have a trombone? Yeah, he had a trombone. Let me see who he had on trombone. Sometimes, some of them jobs, he wasn't using no trombone. He wasn't using no trombone. When he come back, you see, actually was just about when he, before he died, if you understand, he wound up when he had no band, he wasn't using no trombone.
